name: Geographx natural-colour New Zealand basemaps
description: Roger Smith's Geographx terrain-driven natural-colour map surfaces and cartographic products.
story: Geographx developed distinctive natural-colour New Zealand terrain basemaps and other terrain-derived cartographic products. Its map design combines elevation surfaces, map features and colour to communicate landforms across print and digital mapping.

These designed basemaps are distinct from the public-domain Geographx-derived 8 m DEM distributed by LINZ. The public Geographx website documents the cartographic products but does not establish a licence for unrestricted reuse of its commercial map artwork. A reported use in TV3 weather graphics remains unverified and is not presented as established history.
